mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, elevated labor market slack signals weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recovery regimes (INDPRO > 98.0), rising industrial production signals accelerating economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 98.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening residential sector activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real estate investment flows into equity markets.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, monetary tightening increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as risk appetite contracts.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS rising) and unemployment decline (UNRATE falling) indicate improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 233.0), a rise in federal funds rate increases equity valuation discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy tightens unexpectedly.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 233.0 and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
